songs.title: C O L D P I Z Z A
Sometimes She Smiles
songs.lyrics:
He spoke of the truth and how it might save her
And she spoke of the trees in Vermont in the winter
|He said we must strive for faith through devotion
While she dreams of the smell of the Indian Ocean
|He spoke in philosophical structure
She spoke of a vineyard, she spoke of her lover
|When he does not understand
You can hear bones breaking in his head
When she does not understand
|Sometimes she smiles
When he does not understand
You can hear bones breaking in his head
When she does not understand
|Sometimes she smiles
He said reason is what separates man from the beasts
And she kissed him and put him at ease

songs.title: Land Locked Heart
songs.lyrics:
Maybe I left you a long time ago
And neither of us knew it
|Would You say I’d lost the plot
Would You say I blew it
|I thought I found a way back home
But now that I’m looking through it
|After all this time we've lost
I think I just outgrew it
|Are we supposed to waste away?
|Empty out my bedroom
Throw all that shit/stuff away
All I'm taking with me now is blank slate
|These days are to short
To live a whole life through
In this land locked
This land locked heart with you
|Maybe I left you a long time ago
and maybe we both knew
|that Wild seeds turn to tall trees
If the youth don’t plow right through it
|So yeah I caught that early breeze
Yeah flew beyond your edges
And when I came back for the holidays
I tried to setting fire to the hedges
|Were we supposed to waste away?
|Empty out my bedroom
The one you kissed me in
The ghost of who I was and who I am cannot begin
|When these days are too short
To live a whole life through
In this land locked
This land locked heart with you

songs.title: Static
songs.lyrics:
At the shoreline in a snowstorm
I was baptized
Like a new born
In the static
|There was a voice inside a dream
Said Lift your head up
Come up clean
Into the static
|You were a wild thing
Pretending to be tame
|I was a wild thing
Trapped inside a cage
|I wasn’t looking for deliverance
When you walked in from the wilderness
|I was yours and you were mine
But Everything returns on time
To the static
|Though the circuit board erased
Flashes of memory still remain
In the static
|In between the ones and zeros
You will find me if you let go
In the static

Love is an ocean

|And our life back at the surface has us struggle through our days
But when sun bursts on the water I feel longing to escape
|Diving deep in the heart

And the ocean has arms
